leadText:
(Japanese: ポケモンレンジャー－Ｔｈｅ　１ｓｔ　ミッション－ Pokémon Ranger -The 1st Mission-) is a Pokémon manga created by Shigekatsu Ihara. It is one of the adaptations of the Pokémon Ranger series games. It stars a beginning Ranger named (Japanese: マイト Maito) as the main character. It was published in CoroCoro Comic issue April 2006.
